'''Colnor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and was present in the [[Crosstown Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] came to the bar to escort a drunken Jedi Master to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].
